trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Plan for around 200 hours at a steady pace — PowerPyx rates the run 4/10 — and expect the long grinds to take most of that time: 250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK scans and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just play the campaign from the start.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story only: keep playing the campaign and it unlocks at the end of the chapter. Before you leave Chapter 1, make a manual save — one meditation spot there may matter for Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only: it unlocks as the campaign reaches the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only: it unlocks as the campaign reaches the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only: it unlocks as the campaign reaches the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story only: finish the campaign's last mission and this gold pops at the end.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play the campaign; there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as you play the campaign; there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as you play the campaign; there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks as you play the campaign; there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks as you play the campaign; there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as you play the campaign; there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Open the in-game 100% checklist once the story is done and work through it — GTADB notes it may not ask for every optional activity or collectible, so follow the checklist rather than guessing. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy on the list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. PowerPyx counts 397 stunt opportunities across the map, and the 100% checklist needs 300, so you will pass 250 on the way to 100% if you chase the checklist.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once. There are nine types — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, bowling and the rest. Just sample one of each; you do not need to win or master any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every range challenge and hit the gold score on each; the ranges are repeatable, so practise the ones you miss until they click.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Fly each listed drone-race location and win the race there; races are repeatable, so learn each course and go again.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as the race itself is one you have not won before — mix street races, off-road and water races to reach 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, out-fish him in the timed challenge, and the trophy pops at the result screen.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade machine and play one game through to its end — finishing is what counts, not the score.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's side-mission strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's side-mission strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's side-mission strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Eight full strands are required, not eight single missions — finish eight stranger questlines end to end. PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which questlines count, so keep a save before finishing each strand.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's side-mission strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's side-mission strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Visit each meditation spot and meditate there. Possibly missable: a Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia adds to the counter and it is not settled whether it is required, so keep a manual save before leaving Chapter 1 and meditate whenever a spot appears.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's hunting strand to the unique animal he wants and take it down.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total, so pick the three whose cards you find first and finish those; you do not need all 18.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK phone app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — any 100 of them count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the in-game challenge list; GTADB notes the 100% checklist may ask for more, so treat 50 as this trophy's own bar and keep going for 100% separately.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears — no shooting your way out is required.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one wanted run with your partner beside you; if the wanted level drops between robberies the chain breaks, so plan the route between shops first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply drive or encounter 100 distinct vehicles — the game logs each new one as discovered, so vary what you drive and steal.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends; a group of enemies in an open fight is the easiest setup.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Find a way out of the airport that is not a scheduled flight — steal a plane and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Tied to the Rhino tanks. The official description is deliberately vague — engage a Rhino tank and follow the on-screen objective through; the trophy pops when the tank encounter is resolved.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines and cameras, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Keep a manual save before the robbery — GTADB notes it is unclear whether the mission can be replayed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so plan for eight even though the trophy asks for five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a moving armored truck, take the cash and get clear of the wanted level.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map — the in-game area checklist tracks your progress, so use it to find the corners you have not been to yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida; the map marks gang operations once you have found them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beach bar and take in the view — the trophy pops once the drink is served.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side — speed and a straight line are all it takes.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete your follow-through — finishing the game is the safe route.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no steps — this one unlocks through a partnership moment as you play, so keep playing the campaign and the side strands with your partner and it will come.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This one tracks the choices you make in story and side missions — play naturally, keep choosing, and it will unlock on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something once and succeed on the second try — retry a failed mission or challenge and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — Leonida hides odd encounters and easter eggs, so explore off the beaten path and this one finds you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past someone and knock them down with a melee swing from the vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Only marked bills laundered through contacts count — sell them through your contact network until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and vehicles — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so spend as you play rather than hoarding.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market — check the in-game property listings and work through them one by one.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Take ten different vehicles and register each one in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
